title: Connector link hello and version negotiation
description: The connector's hello and the hub's answers (C-05.12 to C-05.14). The version facts are web-chat's own (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/core/versions.js packageVersion, PROTOCOL_VERSION 3, PORTAL_PROTOCOL_VERSION 12, SCHEMA_VERSION 4) inside contract 12's records.

hello.description: The connector's first frame after auth.ok (C-05.12). Direction: connector to hub.

ch.description: The channel this frame travels on (C-05.10).

kind.description: The frame kind within its channel.

id.description: This frame's id, unique per sender per connection. A reply names it in `re`.

seq.description: Per connection, per channel, per direction: 1 for the first frame, plus 1 for each next (C-05.11). Durable positions live in the bodies (contract 07 cursors, hub_msg_id, contract 06 rev), never here.

at.description: When the sender built the frame. Informative; never used for ordering or expiry.

versions.description: The connector's versions record (contract 12, C-12.12), its protocol range included.

route_table.description: The route table the connector's gate enforces (contract 04, C-04.19).

sha256.description: sha256 of the table's canonical JSON (RFC 8785: keys sorted, no whitespace), as 04 C-04.19 and schemas/04-route-table.json define it.

capabilities.description: Optional features a side offers (C-05.12). Protocol 1 names: relay.http, relay.ws, relay.answer, relay.decision_ref, events.batch, events.signals, authority.log, queue.message, key.rotate. An unknown name is ignored, never refused.

hello_ack.description: The hub accepts the link and fixes its parameters (C-05.12 to C-05.14). Direction: hub to connector.

ch.description: The channel this frame travels on (C-05.10).

kind.description: The frame kind within its channel.

id.description: This frame's id, unique per sender per connection. A reply names it in `re`.

seq.description: Per connection, per channel, per direction: 1 for the first frame, plus 1 for each next (C-05.11). Durable positions live in the bodies (contract 07 cursors, hub_msg_id, contract 06 rev), never here.

at.description: When the sender built the frame. Informative; never used for ordering or expiry.

re.description: The `id` of the frame this one answers.

protocol.description: The protocol chosen: the highest both ranges hold.

hub.description: The hub as the connector should record it.

id.description: The hub's stable short id, minted when the hub is installed. Contract 06 names the connector's state and key files after it.

machine.description: The machine record as the hub holds it.

id.description: The machine's hub id (contract 03: `mch_` and 26 lowercase Crockford base32 characters).

name.description: The name shown in Settings > Machines.

capabilities.description: Optional features a side offers (C-05.12). Protocol 1 names: relay.http, relay.ws, relay.answer, relay.decision_ref, events.batch, events.signals, authority.log, queue.message, key.rotate. An unknown name is ignored, never refused.

heartbeat_ms.description: Heartbeat period, each direction, in ms: 15000 in protocol 1 (C-05.17). Contract 07's liveness states are multiples of it (C-07.34).

dead_after_ms.description: Silence after which either side treats the link as dead, in ms: 45000 in protocol 1, three missed beats (C-05.17).

windows.description: Flow-control parameters for this connection (C-05.21 to C-05.25).

relay_stream_bytes.description: Initial credit per relay stream, each direction, in decoded payload bytes. Protocol 1: 262144.

relay_streams_max.description: Concurrent relay streams per connection. Protocol 1: 256.

relay_streams_per_chat.description: Concurrent relay streams per chat. Protocol 1: 64.

signals_unacked.description: Derived signal frames the connector may have unacknowledged. Protocol 1: 256.

batches_unacked_per_chat.description: events.batch frames per chat the connector may have unacknowledged. Protocol 1: 4.

frame_bytes_max.description: The largest text frame either side sends. Protocol 1: 1048576.

compat.description: The hub's verdict on the hello (contract 12, C-12.13): ok, ahead or behind here; refused goes in hello.refused.

hello_refused.description: The protocol ranges do not meet (C-05.13). The hub closes with 4426 next. Direction: hub to connector.
